info.title: ACNH Power Pockets
info.author: chatelp
info.description: On-console pocket and Bells editor for Animal Crossing: New Horizons 3.0.x
info.details:
Edits the pocket slots (20, 30 or 40, as many as you have unlocked), Bells, Nook Miles and the house loan of the primary resident, directly on the console. Fork of ACNH Save Editor by cbreezy210: the save engine is his, the interface is new.

- Pick an item once, then each press of Y drops it in the next empty slot. Occupied slots are never overwritten.
- Every change is staged and shown in a Review screen (before > after); nothing is written until you press Apply.
- Quantities stop at each item's real stack limit; about 10,500 items that never stack are marked 1/slot.
- 69 built-in favorites, plus your own, managed in the app.
- Turnips panel: this week's Stalk Market prices, read from the save (read-only).
- Integrity hashes recomputed and checked before every write; SD backups before every write and a pre-edit backup.

WARNING: this app writes to your save. Back up your save with JKSV or Checkpoint first, and use it offline. Launch it by holding R while starting Animal Crossing (title override), not from the Album.

Item data from NHSE (GPL-3.0), font Varela Round (OFL 1.1).

changelog:
v1.3.0
> [!CAUTION]
> This app writes directly to your Animal Crossing: New Horizons save, and a corrupted island may be impossible to recover.
> Back up your save with JKSV: https://github.com/J-D-K/JKSV or Checkpoint: https://github.com/BernardoGiordano/Checkpoint before every editing session, and copy that backup to a computer.
> Tested on one console and one save only- (game 3.0.3). Use it offline. No warranty of any kind.

New: collections in the Catalog.- Furnish a Japanese room, a whole furniture series or an HHA theme without typing a single name.



 What's new

- Browse collections.- A box next to the Catalog search opens 113 collections in five groups: styles, furniture series (49), HHA themes (46), clothing styles (6) and clothing themes (11). A- opens one and lists its items A to Z; B- goes back. Take an item as usual, then Y- drops it in your pockets.
- Japanese, traditional.- A hand-made style of 224 items with their color variants: 66 pieces of furniture (the game's "Japanese Style" tag, plus the imperial, bamboo and cherry-blossom series) and 139 clothing items (kimonos, yukata, hakama, zori, samurai outfits…). Lunar New Year and "Chinese" items are left out.
- Filter by type with ZL / ZR: All, Furniture, Walls, floors & rugs, Clothing, Other. It works on search results and on collections.
- X searches from any page- of the Catalog, not only from the search field. A search replaces the open collection.
- Very wide searches no longer draw a row of page dots across the panel.

 Where the collections come from

The new file item_collections.txt is generated from the community Data Spreadsheet for Animal Crossing: New Horizons: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mo7myqHry5r_TKvakvIhHbcEAEQpSiNoNQoIS8sMpvM, as JSON in Norviah/animal-crossing: https://github.com/Norviah/animal-crossing (MIT), at a pinned commit. Thanks to everyone who keeps that spreadsheet. Every build checks the file still matches that data. Only items whose name matches items.txt are kept, so a collection never shows an unrelated item.

That data dates from January 2022: items added in game updates 2.0 and 3.0 are not in any collection yet, and the type filter shows them under Other. Without the file, the Catalog works as before.

 Checked on the console

Browsing collections, the type filter, X from any page and taking an item from a collection into the pockets were checked on the console (ACNH 3.0.3).

The save engine is unchanged; a script checks it on every build. This release changes nothing in what the app writes.

 Install or update

1. Extract ACNH-Power-Pockets-v1.3.0.zip to the root of your SD card and overwrite the old files. Your favorites, loadouts and backups stay.
2. Fully close Animal Crossing (HOME › X › Close).
3. Hold R- while starting Animal Crossing to open the Homebrew Menu, then launch ACNH Power Pockets.
